title: Count good parts and rejects
brief: Each press of Good part adds 1 to GoodCount, and each press of Reject adds 1 to RejectCount: once per press, however long the button is held. Total shows GoodCount + RejectCount. RejectPct shows the rejects as a whole-number percentage of the total (1 reject in 3 parts is 33). Before the first part there is nothing to divide by, and the PLC must keep running.
hints: Count with ADD: a rising-edge contact of GoodPB, then ADD GoodCount + 1 into GoodCount. Without the edge it adds 1 on every scan the button is held.
Total: an ADD box with no contact in front, so it works out the sum on every scan.
Percent: whole numbers drop the remainder, so 1 / 3 is 0. Multiply by 100 first, then divide: (RejectCount x 100) / Total.
DIV by 0 stops the PLC. Put a compare in front of the MUL and DIV so they run only while Total is more than 0.

scenarios.name: Two good parts and one reject

assertions.says: Two presses of Good part: GoodCount should be 2.
One press of Reject: RejectCount should be 1.
1 reject in 3 parts is 33 % (33.3, and whole numbers drop the .3). If you see 0, the program divides before it multiplies: 1 / 3 is 0 in whole numbers.

scenarios.name: No parts yet, then one good part

assertions.says: Before any part, Total should be 0.
After one good part, Total should be 1. If it stayed 0, the PLC stopped: did it divide by Total while Total was 0?
One good part and no rejects is 0 % rejects.

scenarios.name: Holding a button counts one part

assertions.says: Reject was held down for 0.7 s but pressed once: RejectCount should be 1. Use a rising-edge contact so ADD runs once per press.

scenarios.name: Two rejects in three, then four parts

assertions.says: 2 rejects in 3 parts is 66 % (66.7 with the remainder dropped).
